PetroVietnam Technical Services Corp Unveils New Offshore Support Vessel in UAE

Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates — PetroVietnam Technical Services Corp launched its latest offshore support vessel in the United Arab Emirates on Tuesday, aiming to expand its service portfolio in the region’s rapidly growing oil and gas sector.

The 4,000-ton vessel, named PTSC Endeavour, will provide logistical and technical support to offshore exploration and production sites in the Arabian Gulf, company executives said at a ceremony held at the Abu Dhabi Port. The launch comes as the UAE continues to invest heavily in upstream oil and gas development, seeking to boost production capacity by 2030.

“We recognize the importance of reliable, efficient offshore support as the UAE pursues its ambitious energy goals,” said Le Minh Quang, regional director for PetroVietnam Technical Services Corp in the Middle East. “With the PTSC Endeavour, we are reinforcing our commitment to delivering safe and innovative solutions to our partners in the region.”

According to the company, the vessel is equipped with dynamic positioning systems, state-of-the-art navigation technology, and can accommodate up to 60 crew members. It will support a range of operations including maintenance, supply runs, and emergency response for offshore installations.

The UAE is one of the world’s top oil producers and has been enhancing its offshore infrastructure to meet rising global demand. The Ministry of Energy and Infrastructure welcomed the launch, noting the contribution to local maritime capabilities and employment.

“Investments such as these are vital for the sustainable growth of our energy sector,” said Ahmed Al Rashid, an official at the ministry. “It strengthens our supply chain resilience and creates opportunities for skilled labor in the maritime and oilfield services industries.”

Industry analysts noted that the addition of the PTSC Endeavour aligns with the UAE’s strategy to become a hub for oil and gas services in the Gulf region. “Demand for offshore support vessels is expected to rise as more projects come online in the next few years,” said Samira Hassan, an energy sector consultant at Gulf Market Insights. “Regional operators are looking for partners with proven safety records and technical capabilities.”

PetroVietnam Technical Services Corp said the vessel would begin operations by the end of June, initially serving projects managed by several international and regional oil companies. The company also plans to explore further investments in the UAE, including training programs for local seafarers.

The event was attended by representatives from industry bodies such as the UAE Maritime Association, who praised the launch as a sign of continued confidence in the sector’s prospects.
